idea-plugin.name: Lockfile Due Diligence
idea-plugin.description:
npm install scripts, integrity and sources under EU CRA Art. 13(5)

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Lockfile Due Diligence: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 8 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/lockfile-due-diligence-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/lockfile-due-diligence-lint

action.text: Lockfile Due Diligence: Check This File
action.description: Run Lockfile Due Diligence on the file in the editor
